servinfo.title: Accessory Drive Belt Tensioner / Idler Pulley Inspection

ptxt.intxrefpoff: Accessory Drive Belt Tensioner / Idler Pulley Removal and Installation:K14D

servinfo.ptxt: Check the following points. If check result is not OK, replace accessory drive belt upper tensioner (1), lower tensioner (2) and/or drive belt idler pulley (3).

item.ptxt: Turn pulleys (4), and check that each pulley rotates smoothly without any abnormal noise.
Check damage on accessory drive belt upper tensioner, lower tensioner and drive belt idler pulley.
